Register of Deeds
The Register of Deeds office contains the history record of all real estate transactions. If a register of deeds is not elected pursuant to section 32-518, the county clerk shall act as ex officio register of deeds.
Books and Indexes which are required to be kept in the office of the Register of Deeds include: Numerical Indexes for all real estate; Deed and Mortgage Records; Miscellaneous Records; Federal and State Tax Lien Indexes and Grantor/Grantee Indexes.
Simplifile is the only solution you need to receive, route, and manage documents from all eRecording submitters.
Email: “Simplifile Support” support@simplifile.com ,
Phone: 800.460.5657
Website: https://mortgagetech.ice.com/products/simplifile
*******************************************************************
**PLEASE NOTE**
The Gosper County Register of Deeds Office will transition to digital record storage effective January 1, 2026 .
What does this mean?
We will no longer produce photocopies of recorded documents for physical record books, and book/page numbers will no longer be assigned. Instead, all documents will be assigned an instrument number only . All records will be stored digitally, microfilmed, and made accessible through Nebraska Deeds Online at: https://nebraskadeedsonline.us .
If you have any questions, please feel free to contact our office. Thank you for your understanding and cooperation.
